scientific_label: local-refinement variable-setting stabilization; not the released all-variable optimizer
trigger: ground-corrected metric-aligned smoke reduced penetration but increased foot sliding from 0.0028626729 to 0.0085135957 m/frame

diagnosis.interpretation: most regression is introduced by changing root orientation and the pelvis-to-foot chains; per-frame root translation is a smaller additional source

candidate.root_translation: one constant xyz delta per person over the sequence
unchanged: paired sample and random shape donor
MMM per-person ground alignment restored to raw coordinates
physical scoring and unchanged paired gate

promotion_gate.first_stage: one identical-sample constant-root smoke must have finite output, exact variable invariants, non-increasing foot sliding, and lower Eq.6 penetration than random shape
promotion_gate.strict_numerical_fallback: if a constant root shift preserves physical foot velocity but fails the unchanged zero-delta gate only through floating-point translation rounding, fix the complete root translation instead of changing the gate; this fallback is frozen before its first execution
promotion_gate.second_stage: five paired timing-positive samples under the frozen selection seed must satisfy non-positive mean foot-sliding delta and non-positive mean Eq.6 penetration delta
promotion_gate.full_stage: the existing 25-pair unchanged bootstrap physical gate must pass before full augmentation
